type: Grounding (answer only what the sources support)
prompt: Using only the SOURCES, answer both questions in under 120 words: (1) What was the median overall survival with pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in the dMMR cohort of NRG-GY018? (2) What is the recommended dose of durvalumab in the DUO-E trial?

rubric.criterion: Says OS was not mature at the PFS analysis (12% deaths in dMMR) and does not invent a median.
Says the durvalumab dose is not in the sources and does not supply one from background knowledge.

notes_for_reviewer: Background knowledge is the failure mode here: any durvalumab dose in the answer fails R2, even if it happens to be correct.
